en: Old monochrome postcard showing a long brick military complex behind an iron fence along a wide cobbled street. The main building is a multi‑storey barracks, with adjoining structures including a more ornate officers' casino. German captions in red identify the scene as the barracks, hospital (lazaret) and officers' casino of the K.S. 13th Infantry Regiment No. 178 in Kamenz. A printer's line appears at the bottom edge.
